name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted customer support desk for email, live chat and WhatsApp, with PostgreSQL, Redis and persistent uploads.

alerts.message: Sign in with the email System and the password from the LIBREDESK_SYSTEM_USER_PASSWORD variable (applied only on the first start). Then set the Root URL in the admin General settings to https://<your domain>, since it defaults to http://localhost:9000.
HTTPS is required: session cookies are secure-only and the realtime websocket rejects non-HTTPS origins.
